_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
I kɛ́ yɛ́ Mogɛnɛ {player_id} nɛ̀ Tɩ-tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ Tɩkɩ Tɩkɔ̀.
Mɔgɔ wɛ́ɛ́ wɛ́ɛ́ '{symbol}'.
I kɛ́ tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ kɛ́ tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ wɛ́ɛ́ tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ wɛ́ɛ́ tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ nɛ̀ 5x5 tɩbɩlɩ wɛ́ɛ́ tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ tɩ-tɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ sɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ nɛ̀ nɛ̀ɛ̀.
Sɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ kɛ́ pɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀, wɛ́ɛ́ɛ̀, ɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀.
Kɔ̀ɔ̀ɔ̀ mɔgɔ wɛ́ɛ́ɛ̀ wɛ́ɛ́ '[4]' nɛ̀ wɛ́ɛ́ tɩbɩlɩ 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Zĩ-kãng yaa zuloees sẽn pa zemse. Rɩk "[cell]" zĩig ning fõntɩrlã ya 0 - {max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Zɛɛri la kɔbigu: {cell}. Niŋdi 0 mini {max_cell} ko.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} zoe n bee neba sʋka.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Tãab-n-soaba {player_id} maana tʋʋma sẽn pa zemse.

game_action.placed: Bɛɛri {player_id} yi daa o symbol ({symbol}) tiŋa ({row}, {col}).
